entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one refined original 2D wuxia anime character concept model sheet for the original series Ou de Jianghu. Horizontal 3:2 canvas, pale warm grey plain studio background. Restrained elegant art direction: crisp precise ink linework, sculpted cel shading, believable adult anatomy, detailed but animation-readable silk folds and metal/jade ornaments, no photorealism, no 3D, no wooden puppet face, no puppet strings, no chibi. Layout: left 40% a large 3/4 bust portrait, right 60% the SAME character in a complete head-to-toe neutral standing view, separated by generous negative space. The face and costume match exactly across both views. Soft neutral diffuse light and subtle grounded shadow, no action effects or environmental narrative. No typography, captions, logos, borders, symbols outside the costume, or watermark. Crown top, hands, shoes, and hems must not be cropped. One person shown twice, no extra characters. This is a candidate concept sheet, not a finished turn-around. Subject: Shen Guihe, a tall slender Chinese man in his thirties, an intelligent composed wuxia strategist. Very long straight ink-black hair falling past waist; a tall WHITE JADE CROWN with ONE single white crane-feather pin, refined geometric crane-inspired original design. Pale calm mature face, narrow grey eyes, subtle gentle but unreadable expression, not feminine or juvenile. Layered WHITE SILK robe embroidered with delicate SILVER CRANES and cloud scrolls, very wide sleeves, PALE BLUE sash. One folded WHITE PAPER FAN held in his RIGHT hand (his anatomical right), with the hand and fan visible and cleanly drawn; no other weapons. The bust portrait shows his whole crown and shoulders, mouth closed; standing pose relaxed, dignified and grounded. Palette ivory white, cool silver, a restrained pale-blue accent, black hair. Keep embroidery limited to readable primary motifs instead of tiny all-over clutter. No injuries, no blood, no bed, no magical glow.
